how_to_apply: Visit the official BPSC recruitment portal at bpsconline.bihar.gov.in.
Open the One Time Registration (OTR) section.
Complete OTR if you are a new applicant.
Existing registered candidates can log in using their registration credentials.
Complete the DigiLocker account connection and consent process, where applicable.
Enter your personal information and contact details.
Provide your permanent and correspondence addresses.
Enter details of your Bachelor's Degree or equivalent qualification.
Complete the other required profile fields.
Enter applicable experience or Government service information, if relevant.
Upload the required live photograph and Hindi and English signatures.
Review and lock the completed candidate profile.
Open the Active Advertisements section.
Select BPSC Assistant Education Development Officer Recruitment, Advertisement No. 16/2026.
Check the declaration and eligibility conditions.
Click the application option and review the details.
Pay the prescribed examination fee by 30 December 2026.
After successful payment, proceed to the final online application form.
Submit the completed application by 31 December 2026.
Open the My Account section and download the final submitted application.
Print and preserve the completed form and relevant supporting documents.

Important: The final submitted application should contain the generated application number, application ID and barcode. Candidates should ensure these details appear correctly on the downloaded document.

content_sections.heading: BPSC AEDO Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Bihar Public Service Commission has prescribed a two-stage written examination for Assistant Education Development Officer recruitment. Online application and eligibility scrutiny. Preliminary Competitive Examination. Shortlisting for the Main Examination. Main Written Examination. Preparation of the merit list based on Main Examination marks. Original document verification. Final recommendation for appointment. Important: The notification does not prescribe a personal interview for the AEDO recruitment. The Preliminary Examination is used for screening, while final merit is based on the Main Examination under the prescribed rules.

content_sections.heading: BPSC AEDO Preliminary Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Preliminary Examination will consist of one General Studies paper with objective-type multiple-choice questions. The General Studies paper will assess candidates' knowledge of the following areas: General Science. Events of national and international importance. History of India and important features of the history of Bihar. Geography of India and Bihar. Major rivers and geographical features of Bihar. Indian polity and governance. Indian economy and economic developments. Changes in Bihar's economy after Independence. Indian National Movement and Bihar's contribution. General mental ability. The official notification specifies one-third negative marking for incorrect answers. Each question has five options, including the prescribed option for leaving the question unanswered. Candidates who do not mark any of the five options may also face the notified one-third deduction. Important: Candidates should follow the prescribed five-option answer-marking method carefully rather than leaving an answer completely blank. Candidates securing the required qualifying marks will be considered for shortlisting according to the applicable cut-off, vacancy and reservation conditions. Merit Clarification: Preliminary Examination marks are not added to the final merit list.

content_sections.heading: BPSC AEDO Main Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted from the Preliminary Examination will be eligible for the Main Written Examination. The Main Examination contains three objective-type papers: General Language, General Studies and General Aptitude. Qualifying Requirement: Candidates must obtain at least 30% marks in both English and Hindi separately. The General Language paper is qualifying in nature. Its marks are not included in the final merit calculation. The Main Examination General Studies paper covers General Science, national and international events, Indian and Bihar history, geography, polity, economy, Indian National Movement and general mental ability. The General Aptitude paper covers the following areas: Number systems and numerical reasoning. Decimal fractions and simplification. Relationships between numbers. Basic arithmetic operations. Percentage, ratio and proportion. Average and interest. Profit and loss. Discount and related calculations. Time and work. Time, speed and distance. Measurement and basic geometry. Logical reasoning and problem-solving. Analytical interpretation. Classification and relationships. Data interpretation. Other numerical and reasoning topics prescribed in the notification. Candidates must also separately qualify in both languages under the General Language paper. Important: The notification explicitly states that re-evaluation of answer sheets is not permitted for the Preliminary or Main Examination.

tables.caption: BPSC AEDO Main Exam Minimum Qualifying Marks

content_sections.heading: BPSC AEDO Final Merit List 2026
content_sections.text: The final merit list will be prepared using the marks obtained in the Main Examination, subject to qualifying requirements and the applicable reservation rules. Final Merit Clarification: The Main General Studies and General Aptitude papers provide the marks used for final merit ranking. Candidates must also fulfill the separate qualifying conditions in General Language. In the event of equal marks, the Commission will apply the tie-breaking conditions prescribed in the recruitment notification.

content_sections.heading: BPSC AEDO Recruitment 2026 Reservation
content_sections.text: Reservation will be provided according to the applicable Bihar Government rules. The notification includes reservation provisions for: Unreserved candidates. Economically Weaker Section candidates. Scheduled Caste candidates. Scheduled Tribe candidates. Extremely Backward Class candidates. Backward Class candidates. Backward Class Women candidates. Eligible women under horizontal reservation. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. Eligible descendants of freedom fighters. The official vacancy table earmarks 319 posts for women under the notified 35% horizontal reservation arrangement. Candidates claiming the benefit must satisfy the relevant Bihar domicile and category-certificate requirements. Applicants seeking reservation benefits under Bihar Government rules must possess the prescribed Bihar permanent residence or domicile certificate and other applicable documents. Candidates claiming reserved-category benefits without the required certificates may be treated according to the Commission's rules.

content_sections.heading: BPSC AEDO Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must apply through the official BPSC online recruitment system. Official Application Portal: bpsconline.bihar.gov.in Application Start Date: 1 December 2026. Fee Payment Last Date: 30 December 2026. Application Submission Last Date: 31 December 2026. Applications submitted by post, email or other offline modes will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: BPSC AEDO Recruitment 2026 Photograph and Signature Requirements
content_sections.text: The notification specifies the following requirements for uploading a photograph and signatures: Upload a clear live photograph using the supported webcam process. Upload the Hindi signature in the prescribed field. Upload the English signature in the prescribed field. Follow the portal's image dimensions and file-size requirements. Check the uploaded files before submitting and locking the profile. The photograph and signatures must be clearly visible. Candidates should verify the displayed files before final submission.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for BPSC AEDO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants should keep the following documents ready for online registration and subsequent document verification: Class 10 certificate or marksheet showing date of birth. Bachelor's Degree certificate or equivalent qualification. Graduation marksheets. Valid photo identity proof. SC/ST certificate, where applicable. BC/EBC certificate, where applicable. Non-Creamy Layer certificate, where required. EWS certificate, where applicable. Bihar domicile/permanent residence certificate for applicable reservation claims. Disability certificate, where applicable. Freedom fighter descendant certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen documents, where applicable. Government service certificate or No Objection Certificate, where required. Recent photograph and scanned signatures. Four passport-size photographs, as prescribed for verification. Final submitted online application form. Examination fee payment confirmation. Original certificates must be produced at document verification. The Commission will verify eligibility according to the original records and applicable recruitment rules.
